limits: Two paired runs do not establish a confidence interval or eliminate shared-host/cache effects. The first pair improves 3.39%, the second 11.93%; do not claim the full mean as a guaranteed code-only gain.
Historical P3 39.204 s was faster than the current optimized mean; it is not a contemporaneous control.
No isolated parsing/decompression/codec CPU attribution: sampled process CPU and inclusive pipeline spans are available, not a new profiler.
Pool maxima are sampled pending requests, not measured connection wait durations; final maxima are 5/4 versus baseline 3/3.
Canonical CPU and block I/O intervals use nearest cgroup samples; worker includes API and Python children. Null I/O means missing cgroup counters, not zero.
